Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.

Marcus Lee (1:05 P.M.) Hi, everyone. My flight back from Denver has been delayed, so I'm still at the airport.
Priya Shah (1:06 P.M.) Should we postpone our 2:00 P.M. meeting, then?
Marcus Lee (1:07 P.M.) No need. If someone can get the room ready for a video call, I can join from here.
Daniel Ortiz (1:09 P.M.) Ms. Park in IT might be able to connect a camera in Room 204 for us. I'll send her a message.
Priya Shah (1:10 P.M.) Should we also invite Owen Brandt? He prepared all the cost estimates for the Harmon Logistics shipping agreement we finalized last month.
Marcus Lee (1:14 P.M.) What about using the media room on the fourth floor instead? People say its camera and speakers work really well.
Helen Park (1:16 P.M.) I can set up the media room for you at around 1:45. I'll be finished well before your meeting starts.
Daniel Ortiz (1:16 P.M.) That's exactly what I was going to suggest.
Priya Shah (1:18 P.M.) Let's not forget to add Mr. Brandt to the invitation.
Daniel Ortiz (1:20 P.M.) Done. Unfortunately, I have a client call at 2:00, so I can't stay. That leaves three of you. Mr. Brandt may be a few minutes late, since he's coming from the warehouse office across the street.
Marcus Lee (1:21 P.M.) That's fine. He can walk us through the next steps for the Harmon agreement.
sets.tr:
Marcus Lee (오후 1:05) 안녕하세요, 여러분. 덴버에서 돌아오는 비행기가 지연돼서 아직 공항에 있어요.
Priya Shah (오후 1:06) 그럼 오후 2시 회의를 미룰까요?
Marcus Lee (오후 1:07) 그럴 필요 없어요. 누가 회의실을 화상 통화용으로 준비해 주면 여기서 참여할 수 있어요.
Daniel Ortiz (오후 1:09) IT팀 Park 씨가 204호에 카메라를 연결해 줄 수 있을 거예요. 메시지 보내 볼게요.
Priya Shah (오후 1:10) Owen Brandt 씨도 초대할까요? 지난달 최종 확정한 Harmon Logistics 운송 계약의 비용 견적을 전부 준비한 분이에요.
Marcus Lee (오후 1:14) 대신 4층 미디어실을 쓰면 어때요? 거기 카메라와 스피커가 정말 잘 된다고들 하더라고요.
Helen Park (오후 1:16) 1시 45분쯤 미디어실을 세팅해 드릴게요. 회의 시작 훨씬 전에 끝낼게요.
Daniel Ortiz (오후 1:16) 제가 막 그걸 제안하려던 참이었어요.
Priya Shah (오후 1:18) Brandt 씨를 초대 명단에 꼭 넣읍시다.
Daniel Ortiz (오후 1:20) 넣었어요. 아쉽게도 저는 2시에 고객 통화가 있어서 못 있어요. 그럼 세 분이 남네요. Brandt 씨는 길 건너 창고 사무실에서 오니까 몇 분 늦을 수도 있어요.
Marcus Lee (오후 1:21) 괜찮아요. 그분이 Harmon 계약의 다음 단계를 설명해 줄 수 있을 거예요.

오답 분석: (A) 2시 전에 사무실에 온다는 말은 없다. 공항에서 화상으로 참여한다. / (B) 204호 공사 얘기는 없다. 더 좋은 방이라 미디어실로 옮길 뿐이다. / (C) Park 씨는 방을 세팅하고 빠진다. 회의를 진행하지 않는다.

questions.explain:

오답 분석: (B) Ortiz 씨까지 세면 네 명이지만 그는 참석하지 못한다고 했다. / (C) Park 씨는 세팅만 하고 나간다. 다섯 명이 아니다. / (D) 여섯 명은 근거가 없다.

He agrees with Mr. Lee about where to hold the meeting.
He believes Mr. Brandt should be invited.
He wants to postpone the meeting.
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 의도 파악
정답 (B) He agrees with Mr. Lee about where to hold the meeting.
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 지문 "What about using the media room on the fourth floor instead?" → "That's exactly what I was going to suggest" → 보기 "agrees with Mr. Lee about where to hold the meeting". Lee 씨가 4층 미디어실로 옮기자고 했고 Park 씨가 그 방을 세팅하겠다고 한 흐름에 대한 반응이다. 같은 생각이었다는 뜻이다.

Questions 164-167 refer to the following text-message chain.

Hannah Cole (2:05 P.M.)
Hi, Leo and Mina. I promised to pick up Ms. Ferreira at the airport at 5:00 P.M., but my car is in the repair shop. Could one of you go instead?
Leo Park (2:06 P.M.)
I'd like to, but I'm leading a training session for new hires until 6:00 P.M.
Hannah Cole (2:08 P.M.)
Is Ms. Ferreira joining that session? If so, it can't really start without her anyway.
Leo Park (2:09 P.M.)
No, she isn't. She's flying in to inspect the new production line at our plant.
Mina Torres (2:10 P.M.)
I can get her. I'm leaving early today, and the airport is on my way home.
Hannah Cole (2:11 P.M.)
Right, Leo. I forgot that the new machines were installed last week.
Hannah Cole (2:12 P.M.)
That works, Mina. Thanks so much.
Mina Torres (2:13 P.M.)
Where should I wait for her? I don't know which flight she's on.

Great, thank you!

아니요. 우리 공장의 새 생산 라인을 점검하러 비행기로 오시는 거예요.

어디서 기다리면 되죠? 어느 비행기를 타시는지 몰라서요.
